description: On /connect the help text under the delegate checkbox sits about 2px above the Approve agent button, while other sections use 16-24px gaps. The paragraph visually merges with the button.
expected: At least 12-16px between the checkbox help text and the primary button.
actual: Text bottom ~654px, button top 656px at 1280x800 (same on mobile).
suggested_fix: Add margin-top to the Approve button or bottom margin to the delegate field.

description: The Approved screen has no next step: no link to the console or to the new agent, and the /connect page has no sign-out or switch-account control, so a person on the wrong account cannot fix it from this page (the story's gap is confirmed).
expected: A 'Go to console' link after approval and a 'Not you? Switch account' link before it.
actual: Dead-end card after approval; Account row is read-only.
suggested_fix: Add a secondary link to /console on success and a switch-account link next to the Account row.

description: The success card says 'Approved' three times (tag 'PAIRED', heading 'Approved', body 'Approved. Return to your agent...').
expected: Heading 'Approved' and body 'Return to your agent; it will finish setup on its own.'
actual: Heading and body both start with 'Approved'.
suggested_fix: Drop the repeated word in the body copy.
